Messages.Author: Gary Schwartz
Messages.Body:
What happens if someone plays a Direct Intervention after
I've played a Telepathic Misdirection (Sup) or
My Enemy's Enemy (Sup). Do I get to untap on not?

Thanks
Gary Schwartz

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <3614E0C4...@math.uiuc.edu>,

schw...@math.uiuc.edu wrote:
> What happens if someone plays a Direct Intervention after
> I've played a Telepathic Misdirection (Sup) or
> My Enemy's Enemy (Sup). Do I get to untap on not?

Not, but also playing the card doesn't tap you, since that effect (along
with the rest of the effect) is canceled by DI.

(So, the answer is: you remain untapped or tapped, as you were before you
played Telepathic Misdirection or whatever.)
